WORKLOG / DOSSIER - task 0 (testing_supply_program_services), frozen_time 2026-10-14 10:20:00 EDT.

1. DRAW AND SCOPE. draw_counts.py --task 0 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [5, 4, 4]}. Factor counts taken: bgm_ext_new_meter_strip_supply 5 (root), bgm_ext_above_coverage_notice 4, bgm_ext_superseded_strip_takeback 4. Occupied before this task: nothing (first task). Claimed here: the three policies and the tools issue_return_authorization_3dfb992f (bgm_return_authorization), sign_liability_notice_3f2fa265 (bgm_liability_notice_signed, owner=user) and ship_strip_refill_72890190 (bgm_refill_shipment). Reserved headroom for task 1 (draw 3 prerequisite problems, factors [6,5,4,5]): the courtesy reship (bgm_replacement_shipment), the payment-plan acceptance (customer's own write), the non-covered charge (bgm_patient_charge) and the hardship waiver (bgm_balance_adjustment) - four disjoint writes on a different tier (Original Medicare), so task 1 keeps an independent problem tree with its own user tool.

2. WHY A GOOD TEST. The customer asks only for strips for her new meter. Getting the shipment right forces the agent to (a) notice that a strip refill whose units exceed the plan's coverage is not shipped until a liability notice signed on or after the newest order stands on file, (b) notice that the notice's units and the refill's units both wait on the take-back of the sealed old-meter strips, (c) work out which shipment she actually holds (the September refill was replaced as delivered but not received), and (d) compute three numbers from a reconciled shipment ledger, two CGM programs (one closed decoy, one on hold) and the CGM tier's hold limit. Difficulty comes from reading policy and records and calculating; every tool is distinct by business object (return authorization, signed notice, strip refill).

3. PROBLEM-TREE CARD.
Root: bgm_ext_new_meter_strip_supply (ship_strip_refill_72890190, agent). Prerequisites: bgm_ext_above_coverage_notice (sign_liability_notice_3f2fa265, owner=user) and bgm_ext_superseded_strip_takeback (issue_return_authorization_3dfb992f, agent). Shape: diamond (take-back -> notice -> refill, take-back -> refill).
Edge A<-B, state_gate, gate bgm_orders.notice_units, form state. Sentence (negated direction, a release): "A strip refill that takes the program's test strips shipped over the 90 days ending on its ship date, that refill counted, above the tier's strip allowance is not shipped until a liability notice for test strips, signed by the customer on or after the date of the newest written order for test strips, stands on the program's file." Four-point test: ordering connective "not ... until"; the waited-on side is a record-visible state (a signed notice row dated on/after the newest order's order_date); no tool, id or code token; strength "not shipped until" matches the condition, scope "a strip refill above the tier's strip allowance over the 90 days ending on its ship date". Exactly one write of this difficulty creates a bgm_liability_notice_signed row (sign_liability_notice_3f2fa265). Derivation: sentence + records (only notice 2026-09-10, before order 2026-09-24) + the notice policy's rule (it sizes and records the tier's notice) -> sign the notice. False at opening: initial_state.bgm_orders.423df92a-5fd6-4d1c-8d88-e1cf492d285a.notice_date = 2026-09-10 < initial_state.bgm_orders.ba0ce403-c03d-48eb-b1b9-b24793425d82.order_date = 2026-09-24. Load: skipping it leaves the refill value 8 but the DB lacks the 8-unit notice and the refill ships units above what the coverage leaves (8 against 4 over its reach) with no notice (terminal hash differs).
Edge A<-E, value_input, gate exchange_units, form state. Sentence (affirmative): "The units of the first strip refill after a newly supplied meter are fixed only after the shipment of strips the customer holds from the latest strip refill, while its return window is open, carries a take-back authorization for any of its units counted as still sealed." Only issue_return_authorization_3dfb992f writes return authorizations. False at opening: no bgm_return_authorization row exists; the held box initial_state.bgm_shipments.92630e67-c39d-4b01-b9e5-f3d0139c3a35.units = 4, delivered 2026-09-25. Load (replay with the take-back skipped): refill 6 instead of 8.
Edge B<-E, value_input, gate window_netting (a plain binding, not a factor: take-back units plus notice units of the last calendar month), form state. Sentence (affirmative): "The units a liability notice for test strips covers are fixed only after the strips the customer holds from the program's latest strip refill, when the meter they were shipped for has since been replaced on the program and their return window is still open, carry a take-back authorization for every unit counted as still sealed." Load: notice 9 instead of 8. The two prerequisite sentences differ in wording and neither contains the other; the charter carries both directions (A<-B negated, A<-E and B<-E affirmative).
Topological order: take-back -> notice -> refill (the only order; every pair is ordered by a sentence). tools_do_not_block: no tool body reads notices or return authorizations; all three create their rows unconditionally. user_scenario names no prerequisite: the return and the form appear only as passive branches after the representative raises them.

4. FACTOR CARDS (figures from the factor-sensitivity run; baseline_result = every factor at its fall-through).
Take-back (expected 2, baseline_result 3).
 - held_shipment_choice (method): ladder replaced-as-not-received/lost -> the replacement from its delivery / no proof of delivery and no such replacement -> nothing / otherwise the refill from its own delivery. Evidence: initial_state.bgm_shipments.d512c866-72b0-4aca-9f36-f7385d3ac0a0 (2026-09-15, 4 units, POD 2026-09-18) and its delivered_not_received replacement 92630e67-c39d-4b01-b9e5-f3d0139c3a35 (2026-09-23, POD 2026-09-25). Tier: replacement. Baseline (refill from 2026-09-18) -> 1.
 - use_end_anchor (method): newer meter delivered later than the latest strip refill (by that refill's own POD 2026-09-18) -> that delivery date / program on hold later than that refill's delivery -> hold start / otherwise today; days that would end before the held strips arrived count as none. Evidence: meter refill 3c529b87-76b0-4d0d-aba3-dcd4e83a6c3e 2026-10-02, POD 2026-10-05. Tier 1 -> 10 days. Baseline (today, 19 days) -> 1.
 - testing_pace (parameter, cross-difficulty cgm, multi-source): insulin-treated AND open CGM regimen insulin_pump -> 5.0 / insulin-treated AND (regimen multiple_daily_injections OR no open CGM) -> 4.0 / otherwise 1.5. Evidence: bgm_programs.treatment_class insulin_treated and cgm_programs.5e50382d-a8ec-4c9f-9486-b02657162327 (on_hold, multiple_daily_injections). Near-miss: the closed 2025 referral 4f56a65f-0ded-416d-8f41-b30abfb9910d records insulin_pump and must be ignored (not open). Baseline 1.5 -> 3.
 - sensor_status_shift (parameter, cross-difficulty cgm): CGM on hold -> +2.0 / CGM active with a sensor refill in 3 months -> -2.5 / otherwise 0. Tier: on hold since 2026-09-01. Baseline 0 -> 3.
 Plumbing: 10 days x 6.0 = 60 strips, ceil(60/50) = 2 opened, 4 - 0 - 2 = 2.
Notice (expected 8, baseline_result 4).
 - coverage_allowance_tier (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty cgm): insulin AND active CGM -> min(insulin, with_cgm) / not insulin AND active CGM -> min(non_insulin, with_cgm) / insulin AND no active CGM -> strips_per_90_days_insulin / otherwise non_insulin. Tier 3 (CGM is on hold, so not active) = 450. Trap: treating the paused CGM as active gives 150. Baseline 150 -> 11.
 - notice_order_rate (parameter): newest strip order not the order behind the latest strip refill and signed within 30 days -> its rate / not behind the latest refill and signed more than 30 days ago -> the lower of the two orders' rates / otherwise the rate of the order behind the latest refill (the same ladder the refill uses, so the notice covers the rate the refill ships at). Tier 1: ba0ce403 (2026-09-24) 6 vs d1ceb096 4. Baseline 4 -> 4. Coverage itself is never raised by a factor: it is the tier's treatment-class allowance, lowered for an active CGM, as the base quantity rules give it; coverage above the allowance would rest only on an over_limit_justification record, and none is on file.
 - notice_reach (method, cross-difficulty cgm): raised order within 30 days on a waiver/agreement tier AND CGM on hold with hold limit after the ship date -> blocks to the CGM hold limit counted up plus one / same AND no CGM on hold -> raised_order_reach_blocks 3 / ABN -> blocks to the order's valid-through (1..12) / otherwise 1. Tier 1: hold limit 2026-09-01 + 60 (CGM HMO hold_max_days) = 2026-10-31, 17 days -> 1 + 1 = 2 blocks. Baseline 1 block -> 6 - 1 = 5.
 - window_convention (method): 30-day tier without prior authorization -> one calendar month against one third / prior-authorization tier -> one month against the PA's monthly units / otherwise 3 months against the whole coverage. Tier 1 (HMO): 450/3 = 150 strips measured. Baseline (3 months: refills 2026-07-17, 2026-08-16, 2026-09-15 = 6 units, less 2 netted = 200 strips, against the whole 450) -> covered 5 -> 7.
 Plumbing: count (4 - 2) x 50 = 100 (the 2026-09-10 waiver falls before the netting month), covered now (150 - 100)//50 = 1, block share (what is measured against the window divided by its blocks) 150//50 = 3, covered over reach 1 + 1 x 3 = 4, notice 6 x 2 - 4 = 8. All baselines: rate 4, one block, non-insulin 150 over 3 months, counted 200, covered 0 -> 4.
Refill (expected 8, baseline_result 4).
 - order_rate_choice (parameter): newest order not behind the latest refill and signed within 30 days -> its rate / same but older -> the lower of the two / otherwise the order behind the latest refill. Tier 1: 6 per 30 days (2026-09-24). Baseline 4 -> 7.
 - supply_span (method): first refill after a newly supplied meter -> days left in the current supply counted up plus one block / grant ends early -> whole blocks to valid-through / otherwise supply_days_per_shipment. Tier 1: 30 - 29 = 1 day -> 1 + 1 = 2 blocks = 60 days. Baseline 30 -> 6.
 - sensor_phase (method, cross-difficulty cgm, CPARAM hold_max_days): CGM on hold with hold limit inside the span -> order rate to the limit, backup rate after / CGM active with sensor supply running -> backup while it lasts, order rate after / otherwise order rate throughout. Tier 1: 17 days x 10 + 43 days x 150/90 = 241.67 strips -> 5 units. Baseline (all at order rate, 600) -> 12.
 - takeback_exchange (parameter): received this month -> received units / issued this month, none received -> authorized units / otherwise 0. Tier 2: +2. Baseline -> 6.
 - setup_allowance (parameter): first refill after a newly supplied meter -> 1 / first refill of a program activated within 30 days -> 2 / otherwise 0. Tier 1: +1. Baseline -> 7.
 Plumbing: min(5 + 2 + 1, order cap 6 x 60 // 30 = 12, grant left 72) = 8.

5. BASE-INVARIANT CARD (all inherited; none retired by an overwrite).
 Take-back (bgm_return_authorization, governed by bgm_evt_returns): return_window (time; anchor bgm_shipments.delivery_date of the held box = 2026-09-25; 30 calendar days counted from it, last day allowed -> through 2026-10-25; 2026-10-14 is day 19; just-fails 2026-10-26); unopened_only (caller statement - the customer reads the replacement's packing-slip number and says two boxes are sealed); no_double_return (no earlier return authorization of that box).
 Notice (bgm_liability_notice_signed, governed by bgm_liability_notice): customer_signs (the customer runs the tool herself; she reads her program number from her refill reminder card).
 Refill (bgm_refill_shipment): program_active (status active); authorization_valid_on_ship_date (grant 4a85fc2e-6850-4ed8-bdaa-c83f19b6b67d valid 2026-09-24..2027-09-23); units_within_authorization (106 cached = 122 credited - 16 shipped; 8 fit); customer_confirmation (HMO refill_confirmation_required true; she confirms daily use and about four strips on hand); refill_not_too_early (previous strip refill d512c866-72b0-4aca-9f36-f7385d3ac0a0 2026-09-15 + 30 - refill_ship_lead_days 7 = 2026-10-08 earliest, inclusive; 2026-10-07 just fails); coverage_recently_verified (last verified 2026-07-08, 6 calendar months -> through 2027-01-08); strip_allowance (the units above coverage ship under the signed notice, as the rule allows); meter_interval (strips only; the next covered meter no sooner than 2029-10-02); strips_match_meter (contour_next_one is on the HMO preferred list); cgm_status_checked (the CGM program is on hold, so no backup reduction applies).
 Automatic clauses checked: no hold reason is true for the testing program (coverage in effect, grant valid, balance 0.00); the CGM program's customer_request hold started 2026-09-01 and its hold_max_days 60 ends 2026-10-31, so no administrative close is owed; the Verio exception grant expired 2026-09-30 and no Verio strips ship after the meter change.

6. BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Take-back object: the replacement box 92630e67-c39d-4b01-b9e5-f3d0139c3a35 (delivered_not_received reship of refill d512c866-72b0-4aca-9f36-f7385d3ac0a0); the original d512c866-72b0-4aca-9f36-f7385d3ac0a0 never reached the customer and is excluded; no other strip shipment is inside its return window. Notice object: the program's A4253 strips under the newest order ba0ce403-c03d-48eb-b1b9-b24793425d82; the window counts strip refills shipped after 2026-09-14 (only d512c866-72b0-4aca-9f36-f7385d3ac0a0), nets the 2-unit take-back (the 2-unit waiver of 2026-09-10 falls before the netting month); lancets, the meter (E0607) and the replacement are not counted. Refill object: the first strip refill under grant 4a85fc2e-6850-4ed8-bdaa-c83f19b6b67d; previous refill d512c866-72b0-4aca-9f36-f7385d3ac0a0; the old grant 2a8b9725-3324-4aa2-9af4-67d24ad3c656 rests on the superseded 4-per-30 order.

7. SEED ROWS. Customer, HMO coverage, the testing program; orders: Verio meter order + exception request + payer exception grant (why Verio strips were covered until 2026-09-30), old strip order 4/30 + grant 48, waiver 2026-09-10 (2 units, as the notice policy sizes it on that date, signed before the 2026-09-15 refill), telehealth note 2026-09-24, new meter order + grant, new strip order 6/30 + grant 72; shipments: 12 monthly strip refills with proofs of delivery (1 unit while the CGM was active - coverage 50 a month; 4 units on 2026-09-15 after the CGM was paused - 2 covered by the notice policy's one-month measure + 2 under the waiver), the courtesy reship and its signature POD, the meter refill and its POD. CGM: a closed 2025 referral (decoy regimen insulin_pump), the Libre 3 Plus program on hold since 2026-09-01 with its order, PA requests and grants (renewed 2026-09-01..2027-02-28), six monthly sensor refills with PODs. Removing the reship changes the take-back (1); removing the waiver changes the notice netting; removing the CGM hold changes coverage, pace, reach and phasing. No cache trap is used (authorized_units_remaining equals the ledger).

8. PERSONA. A warm, precise retired librarian; volunteers only the surface goal (strips for the new meter), the doctor's plan (about ten checks a day while the Libre is paused - matches the 6-per-30 order and the CGM hold) and the meter's arrival. Given only when asked: name/phone (locate), DOB/ZIP (verify), email, program number (refill reminder card), daily use and strips on hand, the story of the replacement box with two sealed boxes and its packing-slip number. Passive branches: agrees to the take-back label if offered; agrees to sign the form if the representative explains the plan will not pay for all ordered strips, and signs with the details read to her; closes once told the strips are on their way and how many boxes. She never mentions returns, forms or limits on her own.

9. STANDARD SOLUTION. find_customers(name, phone) -> verify_customer_identity(DOB, ZIP) -> find_bgm_programs -> find_coverages -> find_bgm_orders -> find_bgm_shipments -> find_cgm_programs -> find_cgm_orders -> find_cgm_shipments -> unlock + call issue_return_authorization_3dfb992f(units 2 against the reship) -> unlock + hand over sign_liability_notice_3f2fa265 (customer signs plan_member_waiver, 8 units) -> unlock + call ship_strip_refill_72890190(grant 4a85fc2e-6850-4ed8-bdaa-c83f19b6b67d, previous d512c866-72b0-4aca-9f36-f7385d3ac0a0, coverage, 8 units, 60 days, payer_claim, confirmed_today). Verification: the scratch evaluator (replicating check_compute; deleted at hand-off) printed E (2, {held_shipment_choice: 1, use_end_anchor: 1, testing_pace: 3, sensor_status_shift: 3, ALL: 3}); B (8, {coverage_allowance_tier: 11, notice_order_rate: 4, notice_reach: 5, window_convention: 7, ALL: 4}), B with the take-back skipped 9; A (8, {order_rate_choice: 7, supply_span: 6, sensor_phase: 12, takeback_exchange: 6, setup_allowance: 7, ALL: 4}), A with the take-back skipped 6. check_compute --task 0: COMPUTE OK.

10. EDGE PROBES (round 3, scratch copies; triple take-back/notice/refill on the opening world, before any write): see the round-3 table in section 18. Earlier take-back and refill probes (new-meter refill after the meter, POD-less refill, meter delivered before the held reship, no meter ever) keep their round-1 figures; those policies did not change. Zero-division and date edges: pa_blocks MX(1, ...), window blocks 1 or 3, DAYS only on non-empty dates (the notice rate tests newest_order_date before DAYS).

11. OVERWRITES. Notice: retires in bgm_evt_quantity_limits the clause "over the rolling 90 days ending on the ship date: strips_per_90_days_insulin ... including the refill being shipped" only for sizing a notice this policy sizes; the replaced_by sentence keeps the class allowances as the starting point, names the CGM adjustment this policy keeps and states that every refill's own allowance check stays under bgm_evt_quantity_limits over the rolling 90 days. Refill: retires in bgm_evt_refill_shipment the clause on supply days and "the units and pieces follow from the supply days" only for a strip refill this policy quantifies; the replaced_by keeps the shortening to the grant's valid-through, adds the meter-change lengthening, and names the base rule for every other refill. Take-back: [] (its count stays within the base cap "units of that shipment, less any units of it already authorized for return"). No two policies retire the same clause.

12. RULE <-> COMPUTE. Forward: every reading, choosing, capping and rounding binding quotes its sentence (compute_basis). Reverse: rounding "rounded up to a whole unit" -> int(ceil) in opened_units and strip_units; "rounded down to whole units" -> // in covered_now_units and block_units, the block share being what is measured against the window (window_allowance) divided by the window's blocks, exactly as the rule now words it; "never below 0" -> MX(0, ...); window "later than the same calendar day ... earlier" -> within_months 1 or 3 (MONTHS(d, today) < N); "counted up to a whole block, plus one" -> ceil(.../30) + 1; caps "never exceed ... the order's rate ... or the grant" -> MN in result.

13. DRAFT FROM THE VISIBLE CONTEXT. Reading only the three policies' rules, the tool schemas, the persona and the finder returns: the held box is the reship (POD 09-25), use ends 10-05, pace 4 + 2 -> 2 sealed; the notice's coverage is 450 (the Libre is on hold), the HMO window is one month against 150, netting 2 (the September waiver is older than the month), covered 1, block share 3, rate 6 (new order within 30 days), reach to the CGM hold limit 2026-10-31 plus a block -> 8; the refill takes the new order's 6, 60 days, phased at the hold limit -> 5, +2 exchange, +1 setup -> 8. Same as gold.

14. REVISIONS. (r1) E's replaced-unit factor was physically wrong (a damaged unit is replaced one-for-one) -> replaced by held_shipment_choice (courtesy reship stands in). (r2) A's notice gate first read "signed within the last 30 days", which the September waiver (then dated 2026-09-15) already satisfied -> re-keyed to "on or after the date of the newest written order". (r3) check_compute: E's history was not load-bearing under SUM/COUNT zeroing -> stand-in detection by COUNT; B's only CGM read (active status) equalled the forced-off value in a paused-CGM world -> the reach gained the paused-CGM tier (hold limit + one block), notice 10 -> 7, propagated to tracing, closure and this dossier. (r4) replay closure: unread billing rows dropped; the CGM order rows kept with a find_cgm_orders read (they are the parents of the sensor refills). (r5) probes: added the superseded-meter scope ("strips fit that meter, nothing is taken back") and status-filtered every CGM field read.

15. FACTOR INDEPENDENCE (coordinator addition). the scratch independence walker (deleted at hand-off) walks every factor binding's names transitively and reports any read of a binding owned by another factor; after r6 it prints OK for all 13 factors and `result` belongs to no factor. Shared record selections are plain bindings stated once in the rule: the latest strip refill and its POD (take-back), the window strip count, the window allowance (the coverage times the convention's share, or the PA units), the newest and prior strip orders (ids, rates, dates, read by both notice_reach and notice_order_rate), the window netting (take-back plus notice units), the latest refill's ship date and the sentence "A refill is the first strip refill after a newly supplied meter when the program already has a strip refill and the meter ship date on the program is later than the ship date of the program's latest strip refill" (refill), and the split of the supply days (MN(span, split) then which side runs at the order rate) is assembled outside the phase factor.

16. METHOD TIERS, PAIRWISE (distinguishing input per pair; world values in brackets).
 held_shipment_choice: T1 replacement vs T2 nothing - a not-received/lost replacement exists (T1 counts its units [2] vs 0); T1 vs T3 refill itself - different shipment and start (reship from 09-25 [2] vs refill from 09-18 [1]); T2 vs T3 - the refill's POD present (T3 counts units) or absent (0).
 use_end_anchor: T1 meter POD vs T2 hold start - different records (meter 10-05 vs a testing-program hold start); T1 vs T3 today - 10-05 vs 10-14 [1 vs 2 sealed]; T2 vs T3 - a hold start before today (equal only for a hold placed today).
 notice_reach: T1 hold limit + 1 (>= 2 because the limit is after the ship date) vs T2 raised_order_reach_blocks 3 - hold limit within 30 days [2 vs 3]; T1 vs T3 ABN and T2 vs T3 - disjoint notice types (waiver/agreement vs ABN); T1 vs T4 one block - T1 is at least 2; T2 vs T4 - 3 vs 1; T3 vs T4 - an order valid 60 days or more ahead gives T3 >= 2.
 window_convention: T1 one month against a third vs T2 one month against PA units - a PA grant's monthly units differ from a third of the 90-day coverage; T1 vs T3 three months against the whole - [7 vs 6]; T2 vs T3 - one month and PA units vs three months and coverage.
 supply_span: T1 rest of cycle + one block vs T2 blocks to grant end - days left in the cycle vs days to the grant's valid-through [60 vs not applicable]; T1 vs T3 standard - [60 vs 30]; T2 vs T3 - a grant ending before the standard supply (fewer blocks).
 sensor_phase: T1 order rate before the split vs T2 order rate after the split - the same split gives opposite allocations; T1 vs T3 all order rate - [17 of 60 days vs 60]; T2 vs T3 - sensor days left > 0 move days to the backup rate.
 (r6) Coordinator additions applied: use_end_anchor now compares with the latest refill's own POD (was the held shipment's date, owned by held_shipment_choice); window_netting has its own one-month span (was the convention's window); the window allowance is a plain binding (was inside window_convention reading the coverage factor); sensor_phase decides only the split and its side (was reading the span); the first-refill-after-a-new-meter test and the latest refill's fields are plain (were inside supply_span and read by setup_allowance); notice_reach tier 1 requires the CGM hold limit after the ship date (so it never equals the one-block fall-through). All figures unchanged: 2 / 7 / 8, sensitivities as in section 4; probes re-run, P8 now [4, 9, 6] (days that would end before the held strips arrived count as none).


17. ROUND-2 REWORK (audit policy_task/testing_supply_program_services). C1: window_netting struck as a factor (its tiers were one sum); the netting is now a plain sentence of the rule and of the baseline paragraph, and regimen_testing_uplift (parameter, cgm; struck in round 3, see section 18) took its place, so the notice keeps 4 factors (2 parameter, 2 method). C4: the rule now says the block share is what is measured against the window divided by its blocks (compute unchanged: window_allowance / window_blocks); the 30-day and 3-month tier sentences use the same phrase. O10: no notice is sized on the Medicare Advantage or self-pay tier (guard). O7: the refill's exchange tier now says strip return receipts recorded on the program, as compute counts. O6: sensor refills are counted across the customer's CGM programs, as the rule now says. O3: the money docstrings no longer claim half-up rounding. Gold: take-back 2, notice 7 -> 5, refill 8; (round 3 re-sized and re-dated the seeded waiver; see section 18).

18. ROUND-3 REWORK. R2-1: regimen_testing_uplift struck (it raised coverage on a ground no payer of the charter grants); notice_order_rate (parameter) takes its place; the newest/prior order selections are now plain bindings shared by notice_reach and notice_order_rate; the baseline paragraph's rate is the order behind the latest refill (the ladder's fall-through). Coverage is only the tier's treatment-class allowance, lowered for an active CGM; coverage above it would rest on an over_limit_justification record, and none is on file. The notice keeps 4 factors (2 parameter, 2 method). The seeded September waiver is re-sized to the 2 units this policy gives on its date and dated 2026-09-10 (before the 2026-09-15 refill), which keeps the window's history load-bearing (a waiver inside the netting month would cancel the whole window count). R2-2 sweep: every prerequisite edge's condition now says what its sentence says (E1 adds the replaced meter and open window; E2 adds the refill-above-coverage antecedent; E3 adds the first refill after a new meter). Gold: take-back 2, notice 5 -> 8, refill 8. Probes (opening world, before any write): opening [2, 9, 6] (the handling-time notice after the take-back is 8); P1 no CGM programs (absent EXISTS/CFIELD/CPARAM) [3, 12, 12]; P2 CGM active instead of on hold [3, 16, 12]; P3 decoy second record: the closed 2025 program re-opened as referral_received [2, 9, 6] (the on-hold program answers first; the CGM charter keeps one open program); P4 Medicare Advantage tier [2, 0, 8] (no notice where none can make the member liable); P5 no written strip orders (None reads) [2, 0, 0]; P6 Medicaid tier with no payer PA on file [2, 12, 6] (pa_blocks floored at 1); P7 a lancet (A4259) notice signed 2026-10-01 [2, 9, 6] (item filter); P8 decoy second strip order of 2026-08-01, older than the newest [2, 9, 6] (LATEST by order_date); P9 newest order lowered to 3 per 30 and signed 2026-08-30 [2, 3, 5] (rate tier 2: min(3, 4); no raised order, one block); P10 no strip refill on file (absent prior order and grant; the newest order answers tier 1) [0, 6, 5]; P11 the waiver dated 2026-09-15 [2, 8, 6] and P12 dated 2026-09-14 [2, 9, 6] (netting month boundary: later than the same calendar day one month earlier).
